steps.text:
I've built the lower third, and it's handed in at `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json` with `record.zip` beside it. The last check came back clean: 0 errors and 0 warnings on every readiness item. I looked at all 23 coverage frames and would air each one.

**Look:** a solid deep-navy panel with a thin blue bar down its left edge. The name is large white Inter, a faint hairline divides it from the role, and the role sits below in a softer blue-grey. There is no other decoration. On the Take the bar rises, the panel opens left to right, and the name then the role slide up into place. Out reverses it quickly.

**Long text:**
- 'Alexandra Konstantopoulos-Vandermeulen' fits on one line at full size, 50px. The panel grows to fit it and stops well inside the title-safe area.
- If a name is longer still, it first steps down in size, to as small as 38px, before it's allowed to wrap. I tested 'Maximiliana Konstantopoulos-Vandermeulen-Oyelaran' and it stayed on one line.
- If it has to wrap anyway, it breaks into two even lines at near-full size. The panel then narrows to the text instead of leaving a gap on the right. The role line works the same way, down to 24px.
